summary: Frontend-only tests for Meelora V2 login refonte (P3.5.b). All 11 requested scenarios PASS: login page loads, bad-password error, password eye toggle, EN/FR language toggle changes UI (DE/IT fallback to FR), forgot-password flow (form, notice, back), Microsoft 'bientôt disponible' notice without navigation, Google button initiates request to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/, remember-me OFF stores token in sessionStorage only, remember-me ON stores token in localStorage only, /reset-password without token renders reset-no-token and disables submit, /reset-password?token=abc shows form and validates short password (<6) and mismatched confirmation client-side.
critical_code_review_comments: Login.js is long (~324 lines) but still manageable; consider splitting the two forms (login vs forgot) into subcomponents if it grows.
ResetPassword.js hardcodes redirect '/' via window.location.href which is fine for this SPA; ensure the URL cleanup is not needed after success.
Google auth callback in AuthContext.js uses setToken(data.token, true) hardcoding remember=true; acceptable since Google flow implies persistent session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login refonte P3.5.b fully validated on frontend. Token storage behavior verified via localStorage.getItem/sessionStorage.getItem through page.evaluate. Google button click intercepted via page.expect_request matching auth.emergentagent.com - do NOT complete real Google login. Real login with admin@accslegro.com/admin123 works and unmounts login-page (Layout renders).
